# Public check Reason catalog

The existing checker and disclosure projection decide verdicts and public facts. Severity, family, descriptions and hints confer no verification, execution or recovery authority. ## binding_json_invalid

Facts: [registered public Reason schema](https://github.com/actql/actql/blob/84d4ef5bff33130b1daec30d56527c4d5c1ef636/spec/contracts/actql-check-reason-catalog.json#/reason_schema), selected by this code; required payload and cross-field constraints remain in that schema.

Only the existing pre-serialization projection may emit caller-owned typed facts and origins; private Source facts are excluded.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"invalid_unicode"}`: The binding JSON contains invalid Unicode text. Use valid Unicode scalar values in member names and string values.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"unexpected_end"}`: The binding JSON ends before a value is complete. Complete the JSON value and its closing delimiters.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"unexpected_token"}`: The binding JSON contains an unexpected token. Use a token allowed by JSON at the reported input location.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"invalid_string"}`: A binding JSON string is invalid. Quote the string and escape control characters using JSON syntax.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"invalid_escape"}`: A binding JSON escape is invalid. Use an escape sequence allowed by JSON.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"invalid_number"}`: A binding JSON number has invalid spelling. Use a valid JSON number, including a complete exponent when present.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"number_out_of_range"}`: A binding JSON number is outside the admitted numeric range. Use a number within the selected input numeric contract.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"negative_zero"}`: The binding JSON contains inadmissible negative zero. Use an admitted numeric value; negative zero is not admitted.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"expected_colon"}`: A binding JSON member is missing its colon. Separate the member name and value with a colon.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"expected_array_separator"}`: Binding JSON array elements are not separated correctly. Use commas between array elements and a closing bracket.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"expected_object_separator"}`: Binding JSON object members are not separated correctly. Use commas between object members and a closing brace.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"duplicate_key"}`: Two binding JSON member names compare equal under the admitted key rules. Choose distinct member names under the input normalization rules.

For `{"document":["parameters","parameter_declarations"],"issue":"trailing_content"}`: Unexpected content follows the binding JSON value. Submit one complete JSON value without trailing content.

Independent acceptance: [JSON parser location survives parameters failure](https://github.com/actql/actql/blob/84d4ef5bff33130b1daec30d56527c4d5c1ef636/adapters/host-node/client-check.test.mjs).

## operation_parameter_invalid

Facts: [registered public Reason schema](https://github.com/actql/actql/blob/84d4ef5bff33130b1daec30d56527c4d5c1ef636/spec/contracts/actql-check-reason-catalog.json#/reason_schema), selected by this code; required payload and cross-field constraints remain in that schema.

Only the existing pre-serialization projection may emit this reason; actual values, private Source distinctions and arbitrary causes are excluded.

Default: A parameter violates an operation scalar domain. Correct the supplied value or selected default under the reported operation domain.

For `{"domain":"positive_safe_integer"}`: An operation parameter must be a positive safe integer. Supply an integer from 1 through 9007199254740991.

For `{"domain":"nonnegative_safe_integer"}`: An operation parameter must be a nonnegative safe integer. Supply an integer from 0 through 9007199254740991; negative zero is not admitted.

For `{"domain":"unit_fraction"}`: An operation parameter must be a finite fraction between 0 and 1. Supply a number from 0 through 1, inclusive; negative zero is not admitted.

For `{"domain":"finite_number"}`: An operation parameter must be a finite number. Supply a finite number; negative zero is not admitted.

For `{"domain":"duration"}`: An operation parameter must be an admitted duration. Supply positive ASCII digits followed by ms, s, m, h or d, without whitespace; the milliseconds must fit a safe integer.

For `{"domain":"positive_milliseconds"}`: An operation parameter must be positive safe milliseconds or an admitted duration. Supply a positive safe integer of milliseconds, or a positive duration string with ms, s, m, h or d.

For `{"domain":"signed_milliseconds"}`: An operation parameter must be signed safe milliseconds or an admitted duration. Supply integer milliseconds from -9007199254740991 through 9007199254740991 without negative zero, or a positive duration string.

For `{"domain":"timestamp"}`: An operation parameter must be an admitted timestamp value. Supply a non-null timestamp value admitted by the timestamp declaration contract.

Independent acceptance: [operation parameter violations explain owned domains and input origins](https://github.com/actql/actql/blob/84d4ef5bff33130b1daec30d56527c4d5c1ef636/adapters/host-node/client-check.test.mjs).

Facts: [registered public Reason schema](https://github.com/actql/actql/blob/84d4ef5bff33130b1daec30d56527c4d5c1ef636/spec/contracts/actql-check-reason-catalog.json#/reason_schema), selected by this code; required payload and cross-field constraints remain in that schema.

Only the existing pre-serialization projection may emit this reason; actual values, private Source distinctions and arbitrary causes are excluded.

Default: A query token violates its lexical syntax. Correct the token at the reported location when available.

For `{"issue":"unexpected_end"}`: The input ends before a token is complete. Complete the quoted token or escape sequence at the reported position.

For `{"issue":"unexpected_token"}`: A token is not valid in this lexical context. Correct the token spelling or delimiter at the reported position.

For `{"issue":"invalid_escape"}`: An escape sequence is invalid. Use an escape allowed by the selected string or identifier syntax.

For `{"issue":"invalid_scalar"}`: A token contains a scalar forbidden by its lexical context. Correct the scalar escape or quoted identifier under the selected lexical syntax.

For `{"issue":"empty_identifier"}`: A quoted identifier is empty. Provide a non-empty identifier inside the quoting delimiters.

For `{"issue":"unterminated_comment"}`: A block comment is not terminated. Add the closing block-comment delimiter.

For `{"issue":"invalid_number"}`: A numeric token has invalid spelling. Correct the numeric token, including any exponent.

For `{"issue":"invalid_parameter"}`: A parameter reference lacks a valid name. Provide a valid parameter name after @.

Independent acceptance: [typed lexical explanations retain the submitted token position](https://github.com/actql/actql/blob/84d4ef5bff33130b1daec30d56527c4d5c1ef636/adapters/host-node/client-check.test.mjs).
